name: node-proxy-tooling
description: Dev tooling only (TypeScript / ESLint / OpenAPI validation). Not part of any runtime image.

scripts.openapi:validate: node server/scripts/export-openapi.ts && redocly lint --extends=minimal server/openapi/generated.json && node server/scripts/check-openapi-routes.ts && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('server/openapi/generated.json',{force:true})"
